title: Japan in Bloom Group Tour
alt: Blossom trees in full flower beside a temple wall, Japan
transport: Coaches, trains and guided touring throughout

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Hiroshima and Kyoto
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Central hotel on Nagahori street, a short walk from Shinsaibashi

activities.name: Hiroshima and Miyajima day trip
activities.description: A long day west to the Peace Memorial Park, then the ferry to Miyajima for the floating torii gate and Itsukushima shrine.

activities.name: Osaka sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city: Osaka castle and its park, the Dotonbori canal and the market lanes around Kuromon.

activities.name: Kyoto and Arashiyama day trip
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, then the bamboo grove at Arashiyama and the lanes along the Katsura river.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Four nights in one central hotel, with day trips to Hiroshima and Miyajima, a city tour and a day in Kyoto with Arashiyama.

stops.name: Nagoya
stops.subtitle: Nagoya to Nara and Nabana no Sato
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel in the Sakae district of Nagoya

activities.name: Todai-ji temple and Nara deer park
activities.match: Trip to Todai-ji Temple & Nara Deer Park
activities.description: The great bronze Buddha inside Todai-ji, then the deer park where the tame sika deer bow for biscuits.

activities.name: Nabana no Sato illumination
activities.description: The flower park near Nagoya, where millions of lights are strung into tunnels and fields once the sun goes down.

program.name: Nagoya
program.description: A night in Nagoya, reached through Nara's great temple and deer park, with the Nabana no Sato lights after dark.

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Hakone
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel at Shin-Urayasu, one stop from Disney Resort

activities.name: Hakone ropeway
activities.description: The cable car over the sulphur vents of Owakudani, with Mount Fuji across the valley when the sky is clear.

activities.name: Lake Ashi cruise
activities.description: A cruise across Lake Ashi past the red torii gate standing in the water at Hakone shrine.

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city, from the Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens to the old temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Three nights near the bay, reached over the Hakone ropeway and Lake Ashi, with a guided city day and a free day.

1: Arrival at Kansai Airport and transfer to your hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: an evening walk along the Dotonbori canal
2: Early breakfast, then a full day west
The Peace Memorial Park and the A-Bomb Dome
The floating torii gate before the ride back
3: Breakfast, then a guided day around Osaka
The Dotonbori canal and Kuromon market
4: Breakfast, then across to Kyoto for the day
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The lanes along the Katsura river
5: Breakfast and check out, then on to Nara
Todai-ji and its great bronze Buddha
The deer park and its tame sika deer
Nabana no Sato illuminations, then Nagoya

Dinner at the hotel in the evening

Transfer to Narita or Haneda for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Starting in Osaka and ending in Tokyo means no backtracking, and the Nabana no Sato lights on the way through are a quiet highlight.
expert.tip: Fly into Kansai and home from Narita if your airline allows it. This itinerary is built that way and it saves a whole travel day.

summary: Nine days from Kansai to Tokyo: four nights in central Osaka with Hiroshima and Miyajima, a city tour and a Kyoto day with Arashiyama, a night in Nagoya via Nara and the Nabana no Sato lights, then three nights in Tokyo reached over the Hakone ropeway.
included: Included: 8 nights with daily breakfast and dinner on four evenings; coaches and trains throughout; a guided day to Hiroshima with the island shrine at Miyajima; a city tour of Osaka; Kyoto with the Arashiyama bamboo grove; Todai-ji temple with the Nara deer park; entry to the Nabana no Sato illuminations; the Hakone ropeway and a Lake Ashi cruise; a guided day in Tokyo.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
